task.maid_smart.mine.desc: Find ores nearby and mine them with a pickaxe
task.maid_smart.organize.desc: Store backpack items into nearby chests
task.maid_smart.cook.desc: Feed furnaces/smokers/blast furnaces with fuel and smeltable items (food or ores), collect the results
task.maid_smart.brew.desc: Feed brewing stands with blaze powder and ingredients, collect potions
task.maid_smart.build.desc: Build a structure block by block from the build plan (materials from backpack)
task.maid_smart.slaughter.desc: Count livestock within 5x5, kill one randomly every 3s when same type exceeds threshold
task.maid_smart.flight_combat.desc: Melee Air Raid: elytra + any melee weapon + firework rocket; jump-glide, launch a firework away+up, fly at the enemy after 1.5s, cancel gliding within 3.5 blocks to free-fall into a critical melee hit, then re-glide and repeat
task.maid_smart.flight_ranged.desc: Ranged Air Raid: elytra + any ranged weapon + firework rocket; launches like Melee Air Raid, then circles in the sky and shoots enemies within range with the held ranged weapon, refreshing a firework every 5s; lands after the enemy dies
config.promaid.build.machineSmart: Redstone machine smart build (machine order + live placement + auto-start)
config.promaid.misc.noPlaceOnOwner: No block placing inside the owner
config.promaid.voice.jarPackMuteNative: Mute native sound pack while playing
config.promaid.combat.flightNoWallDamage: Flight: Immune to Elytra Wall Impact
config.promaid.combat.flightNoFallDamage: Air Raid: Immune to Fall Damage
task.maid_smart.index_build.desc: One-off temporary build triggered by the index stone (hidden task)
